title: Note
description: A clinical note written by a researcher about a participant, visible to the researchers involved in the study

studyKey.description: Database key of the study this note belongs to

participantUserKey.description: User key of the participant this note is about

authorUserKey.description: User key of the researcher that wrote the note

authorEmail.description: Email of the researcher that wrote the note, denormalised for display

createdTS.description: Timestamp of when the note was created, as ISO date string

updatedTS.description: Timestamp of when the note was last updated, as ISO date string
